findings.source_quote: The wrath of God is being revealed from heaven against all the godlessness and wickedness of people
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “juu ya uasi wote wa Mungu na udhalimu wa watu” with “juu ya kutomcha Mungu kote na uovu wa watu” to avoid saying that God is in rebellion.
findings.translation_quote: Hasira ya Mungu inafunuliwa kutoka mbinguni juu ya uasi wote wa Mungu na udhalimu wa watu
